page: Microsoft Azure E128pds_v7 belongs to the Epdsv7 family of memory-optimized virtual machines powered by 64-bit ARM architecture. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, this configuration delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for workloads with demanding memory footprints. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs.

Storage capabilities consist of 7559 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD disk space, supplemented by capability for Azure Premium Storage. The substantial local disk volume acts as fast temporary storage for caching and ephemeral data, while persistent data is offloaded to managed network disk arrays. The absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses requires network configurations to incorporate private subnets or separate address routing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 platform offers a balanced hardware density profile, enabling organizations to deploy massive memory structures and thread-level parallelism while maintaining architectural power efficiency. A potential tradeoff lies in software stack compatibility, requiring workloads and libraries to be compiled for ARM64 environments rather than standard x86-64 systems.

The extensive core count and memory allocation make the E128pds_v7 well aligned for in-memory databases such as Redis, large relational database management systems, big data processing frameworks, enterprise distributed caching tiers, and memory-bound analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E128pds_v7 is a memory-optimized cloud server built on 64-bit ARM architecture. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance provisions 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1024.0 GB of memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage architecture includes 7559 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage, along with compatibility for Premium Storage volumes. The server features no discrete GPU hardware. The combination of dense ARM core counts and expansive system memory delivers cost-effective compute and memory density without the typical thermal and operational overhead of traditional x86 footprints. With extensive memory space and fast local disk throughput, the E128pds_v7 is designed for demanding in-memory enterprise databases, extensive caching layers, big data analytics engines, and high-throughput transaction processing workloads that require low-latency memory access and local temporary disk buffering.
